title: RAW_UNREVIEWED: shared pool relation versus static inventory for qol chedy qokeey
summary: GDT1055 fixes qol chedy qokeey at f81r.20 and f82r.21. GDT791 assigns the first line to f81r's lower pool and the second to f82r's bottom communal record, but neither atlas supplies a single-word image owner. Test whether the whole triple states a repeated directed relation within both depicted systems, or names a static material/state, using independently marked visual endpoints and the full neighboring lines. GDT823's source-anaphor reading and GDT850's joined/split counterexample remain active predecessors.

design.mechanism: The whole three-group construction encodes a portable relation between source and outcome in pool/apparatus descriptions, without fixing individual word glosses.
design.unit: The two GDT1055 loci f81r.20 and f82r.21 and their separately identified visual record owners; alternate readings count as one source.
design.contrast: Directed source-to-outcome account versus static material or category inventory; source anaphor for qol remains only one unselected subcase.
design.prediction: Before decoding, independent image annotation must nominate comparable directed endpoints at both owners and a consistent alignment for the full lines. An absent or reversed relation, or equally fitting static-owner model, blocks semantic selection. No inference from qokeey's neighboring joined/split distribution because GDT850 retains a counterexample.
design.scope: Raw exploratory proposal; use already admitted images and records, no reserves or new token gloss. Primary records GDT1055 RESULT.json, GDT791 REPORT.md, GDT823 WORKING_THEORY.md and GDT850 REPORT.md.
